[Thinking]
**Correcting Warrior I**

I'm focusing on refining Warrior I. I'll address the spine and arm alignment, then ensure the knee is properly stacked over the ankle. My feedback will be encouraging yet direct to guide the student effectively.

**Refining Warrior Pose**

I'm adjusting the foundational elements of Warrior I, ensuring the front knee tracks precisely over the ankle for optimal joint health. My focus is now on elongating the spine, extending from the tailbone to the crown, and engaging the triceps to find greater reach and stability in the arms.
[/Thinking]

Great work on your Warrior One! I can see the focus and strength you're bringing to the mat today. To help you feel even more stable and powerful in this pose, let’s make a few small refinements together.

First, let's look at your foundation. Check your front leg and make sure your knee is stacked directly over your ankle. Aligning them this way provides the best support for your joints and helps you feel more grounded.

Next, let's bring some awareness to your torso. Reach up through the crown of your head to ensure your spine is perfectly straight. Think about creating a long, vertical line of energy from your hips all the way up through your neck.

Finally, let's energize those upper limbs. Reach your arms straight up toward the sky, fully extending them and engaging your triceps. Imagine you are trying to touch the ceiling with your fingertips.

There it is! That looks much more aligned and strong. Keep breathing through it—you’re doing an excellent job with these adjustments.
